name: New File Alert
description: When a new file is created in the project, remind Kiro to check if it needs to be linked in index.html.

then.prompt: A new file was just created in the To-Do List project. Please check if this new file needs to be linked or referenced inside index.html (for example a new .css file needs a link tag, or a new .js file needs a script tag). If yes, suggest the exact line to add.
